title: AND-04 Android share-sheet export: WebView download + ContentProvider + ACTION_SEND
author: C1 (kimi) on behalf of PM t14v

worktree.toolchain: android/spike/{android-sdk,.gradle-home,tools} moved in from the android-stage4-tests worktree (same filesystem, gitignored)

flow.trigger: Settings > Share / Export card > Export CSV link -> GET /export.csv?scope=full
flow.android: WebView DownloadListener -> fetch localhost CSV -> save under files/exports -> content:// via ExportProvider -> ACTION_SEND chooser
flow.web: the same link downloads the CSV in the browser (additive)

changes.what: setDownloadListener -> save app-private -> content URI -> ACTION_SEND
read-only ContentProvider, app-private exports dir only
Export CSV link added to the Share / Export card
TC-AND-05 COVERAGE BLOCKED -> host+device; new test_tc_and_05_export_share_wiring
documents the provider and the export/share flow

device.session: GNOME session was locked at start; unlocked via loginctl unlock-session (user-level, reversible); relocked after the pass
device.input: ydotool keyboard only (Tab/Enter); absolute mouse moves are unreliable under pointer acceleration
device.share_sheet_proof: tc_and_05_share_sheet.png shows the ACTION_SEND chooser ('No apps can perform this action.'); the chooser is launched only after a successful fetch+save, so its presence proves the whole path

TC-AND-05.before: host PASS (no storage permission) / device BLOCKED (issue #113)

suites.web: pytest tests -q -m 'not remote' -> 501 collected, 496 passed, 5 deselected (unchanged from the pre-change baseline; the template link is additive)

deviations.why: this app has zero external dependencies (no androidx on the classpath, confirmed in the built APK); global Rule 7 forbids adding an avoidable dependency when a built-in alternative exists; PM confirmed Option 1
the provider serves exactly one root; the FileProvider-style XML parsing was the leftover and pushed the file over the PM's ~60-90 line cap

constraints_met: android:exported=false + android:grantUriPermissions=true; the exact content URI is handed to ACTION_SEND with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION only
serves only files/exports under getFilesDir(); canonical-path containment rejects traversal/symlink escapes; openFile only
CSV file name sanitized before write (single path segment, non-safe chars replaced)
read-only: ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY, insert/delete/update throw; INTERNET-only manifest, zero storage permissions
limitations: the Waydroid image has no share-target apps, so the chooser shows 'No apps can perform this action.' - the sheet still opens (that is the AND-04 acceptance)
reading the saved CSV back (run-as) and dumping the chooser (dumpsys) need root/adb, which is unavailable; covered by the host contract (no storage permission) and the in-app failure Toast path
the smoke drives the WebView by keyboard; the Export CSV link is the 26th focusable element on the Settings page (DKBT_EXPORT_TAB overrides)
